content.value: A.manufacturer of leather belts makes three types of bets $\mathsf { A } _ { \flat } ^ { \prime \prime }$ B and C which are processed on threé machines $M _ { 1 } , M _ { 2 }$ and $M _ { 3 } .$ Belt A requires 2 hours on machine $\mathsf { M } _ { 1 }$ and 3 hours on machine $\mathsf { M } _ { 3 }$ Belt B requires 3 hours on machine $M _ { 1 } , 2$ hours on machine $M _ { 2 }$ and 2 hours on machine $\pmb { M } _ { 3 }$ and belt C requires 5 hours on machine $\mathsf { M } _ { 2 }$ and 4 hours on machine $M _ { 3 }$ There are 8 hours of time per day available on machine $\displaystyle { \mathsf { M } } _ { 1 } ,$ 10 hours of time per day available on machine ${ M } _ { 2 }$ and 15 hours of time per day available on machine $M _ { 3 } .$ The profit gained from belt A is Tk. 3.00 per unit, from belt B is Tk. 5.00 per unit and from belt C is Tk. 4.00 per unit. Solve this LPP using simplex method so that the profit is maximum.
